title: LSU's Mansoor Delane leads group of top 8 DBs in 2026 NFL Draft class: Insights from 'Football 301'

sources.title: LSU's Mansoor Delane leads group of top 8 DBs in 2026 NFL Draft class: Insights from 'Football 301'
sources.description: This 2026 class may lack an undisputed Jalen Ramsey or Sauce Gardner, but it offers a raft of smart, athletic and competitive defensive backs ready to fill starting roles — and potentially develop into more.
